faq_eligibility: Who can register as an agent?

faq_fees_answer: Registration is completely free. You only pay when you make bookings through the platform at discounted wholesale rates.

faq_commission_answer: You earn commission on every booking made through the platform. Commissions are tracked in your dashboard and paid out according to the agreed schedule.
